title: Is the sector-reversal gate's baseline-vs-gated gap statistically distinguishable from noise?

tables.name: Bootstrap 95% CI + permutation test on (gated - baseline)

notes: Companion significance check to sector_reversal_gate_backtest.py's baseline-vs-gated comparison, since 'never flips sign' turned out to be necessary but not sufficient. VALIDATION avg_pct gap's 95% CI includes zero and the permutation p-value is 0.852 -- this exact result would occur from pure chance the large majority of the time.

conclusion.summary: Validation-split edge is fully consistent with noise (p=0.85) despite never flipping sign across three independent windows and this causal gate test.
